title: brucea javanica
intro: Brucea javanica, commonly known as Qilin or Quilin, is a traditional medicinal plant native to China and Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Brucea javanica include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antitumor properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. These constituents are responsible for the plant's ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant and antiviral activities.
